rules.rule: ConfigMorph review priorities. Critical: parser semantic regression; unsafe renderer emission; weakened CP1 blocking; unsafe CP2 emission; adjacent-version evidence inheritance; silent unknown-version mapping; raw configuration or secret logging; unsafe XML handling; source-size limit bypass; project archive traversal; stale results shown as current; candidate copy enabled for REVIEW REQUIRED or BLOCKED. High: stable schema breakage; provenance loss; nondeterminism; project-persistence incompatibility; null backend fields crashing React; virtualization loss; remote runtime dependency. Medium: accessibility regression; excessive DOM rendering; duplicate analysis; inconsistent error handling; stale artifact handling. Preserve local-only runtime, exact-version evidence, CP0/CP1/CP2 semantics, 100 MiB source limit, and evidence source-exclusion defaults. Review only; never auto-fix or auto-commit.
